slot_note: DATASET_NOTES.md holds builds 1 to 4 and four revisions of build 4; the build on disk is revision 4.
niche: one-shot January replenishment buy across six buildings that cannot transfer stock, imported families ordered quarterly and domestic monthly
answer: Put 493,000 eaches on the January order.
stakeholder_role: replenishment planner at a North American wholesale distributor of electronics and appliances

spine.entity: one row is one SKU's stock position at one building on one weekly snapshot
spine.grain: SKU x building x week, 2024 to 2026

world.geography: United States (six DCs in GA, TX, OH, NJ, MS and NV)
world.org_type: wholesale distributor of consumer electronics and appliances

driver: The decisive quantity is a sum of per-cell shortfalls each floored at zero, because surpluses cannot transfer between the sites the pooled position adds together, so netting at the pooled grain, which looks balanced, understates the commitment; each cell's cover period also runs to the next arrival on its own supply cadence.
driver_concrete: Each region-family is served from exactly one of six buildings and stock never moves between them, so the buy floors each building's shortfall over its arrival-to-next-arrival period at zero before summing, 492,981 eaches, where netting the network (859,057 held against 867,520 needed) gives 443,080.
stump: Files about 443,100 eaches (443,080) by netting plan-of-record demand against the network-wide position, which reads as balanced at 859,057 held against 867,520 needed, instead of flooring each building's shortfall at zero before summing.

lineage.fate: three independent frontier reports returned Swiftline off one lane x service groupby, because the lane key encoded the origin DC and cancelled the capacity confounder for free
lineage.driver: The candidate to drop has the largest excess of late outcomes after controlling for a shared origin capacity constraint, with a handling authorisation stranding a rival's volume, but a within-cell contrast on a key that encodes the origin cancels the confounder for free.

lineage.architecture: build 3 (drop one carrier, planted delivery partition)
lineage.fate: found illegal under Gate G v3 on 2026-09-16 (planted_defect_flip on 3,045 fabricated proof-of-delivery dates) and replaced before any portal run
lineage.driver: Repairing a planted block of fabricated completion dates inverts the ranking of candidates on excess late outcomes, with duplicated rows inflating every candidate except the answer.

lineage.fate: rev 1 failed the determinism rehearsal on Gates C, D and E; rev 2 measured 46 and 25 per cent on the portal; rev 3, forks closed, was solved by both top responses at about 95 per cent (2026-09-16)
lineage.driver: The period a one-shot commitment must cover runs from its own arrival to the next arrival on its supply cadence, which for long-lead sources runs past the planning quarter and for short-lead sources ends inside it, so netting quarter demand errs in opposite directions on the two halves.
